summary: Fixed Center requests reusing the startup reference and verified the new center persists through timebase replay.

intervals.description: Trace raw center and timebase replay in the project-local checkout, fix the stale reference handoff, and verify all raw modalities and native renderer transitions.
evidence: Focused unittest command: tests.test_raw_render tests.test_raw_snapshot tests_gui.test_rendering_regressions and VisPy recenter geometry check

results: Root cause: PlotController passed the latched reference to preparation for explicit Center requests, causing prepare_raw_window to reuse the old baseline; timebase replay then preserved that baseline.

Center requests now pass reference=None so preparation calculates a fresh center. Added regression coverage for EEG, PPG, and EDA and verified the new reference is reused on a later VisPy timebase replay.

Focused suites passed: 33 tests. Native Windows/OpenGL validation passed 30 renderer/channel/timebase transitions, Center and autoscale across EEG/PPG/EDA, and 21 alternating 5 s/300 s memory transitions; errors array was empty.
limitations: Verification used deterministic synthetic signals; no user-provided recording exhibiting the artifact was available for pixel-by-pixel comparison. No commit or push was made; pre-existing local work was preserved.
